content.text:
Perfect! All 85 tests pass. I've created the text rendering module:

**`src/render.js`** — `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` returns a plain-text invoice with:
- First line: invoice number (or "DRAFT" if not yet issued)
- Second line: customer name (looks up from customers database)
- One line per invoice item showing: `qty × product name @ unit price = line total`
- Final line: `Total: <total amount>`
- All monetary amounts formatted with `formatEuros()` (€ symbol, thousands separators, two decimals)
- Gracefully handles unknown customers with a fallback message

**Sample output:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5 × Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
3 × Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €285.00
Total: €710.00
```

**Tests** (15 new, 85 total):
- Draft and issued invoice rendering
- Customer name resolution (including missing customers)
- Line formatting and amounts
- Multiple lines with correct totals
- Various products and quantities
- Large amounts with proper formatting

All 85 tests pass. ✅
